a1b2c3d4-0011-4000-8000-000000000009.body: Hover over a city to see its name and population. Click one and the last cell names it.

a1b2c3d4-0011-4000-8000-000000000010.body: Scatter the cities the way you normally would. The tooltip template shows each point's city and pop, and the tooltip's border uses the marker's color.

a1b2c3d4-0011-4000-8000-000000000011.body: bind = s makes pick the clicked city itself. @bind pick saves a click in pick, while hovering only shows the tooltip and leaves pick as it was.

a1b2c3d4-0011-4000-8000-000000000012.body: pick starts as nothing, and this cell responds when you click a city.
